item.text:
Turn complete. Report updated at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-09_14-01-25-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md).

This turn I isolated the protocol-version/upgrade family to check whether any failure there has a *different* signature (which would point at a second defect).

I ran `-count=15` over `TestRaft_ProtocolVersion_RejectRPC`, `TestRaft_ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_1_2`, `TestRaft_ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_2_3`, and `TestRaft_SnapshotRestore_PeerChange`. There were 8 failures, and **every single one is the same `peer mismatch` at `testing.go:705`**:

- `TestRaft_ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_2_3` — 6/15
- `TestRaft_ProtocolVersion_Upgrade_1_2` — 2/15 (a third affected shipped test)
- `TestRaft_ProtocolVersion_RejectRPC` — 0/15
- `TestRaft_SnapshotRestore_PeerChange` — 0/15

No other failure mode appeared. That both broadens Finding 1's impact (three shipped tests) and further confirms there is no separate anomaly in this area. Log preserved durably at `audit-evidence/proto_family_c15.log`, and the report's finding text and summary were updated accordingly.

The audit remains consistent and complete:

- Finding 1 (confirmed, low severity): `testing.go`'s `EnsureSamePeers` freezes its reference peer set outside the retry loop, so peers-after-config-change checks can fail on a healthy cluster. Confirmed in three shipped tests, causally validated by a one-line fix in a scratch copy (both re-tested cases went to 0/20), mechanism-verified by goroutine dump and a propagation-lag measurement (15% stale-at-first-read, otherwise microsecond lag).
- No consensus-level defect: full source review of the root module plus five independent behavioral methods (~16k acked commands across randomized partition, snapshot-catch-up, and mixed-version harnesses).
- One open item, unanswerable offline: whether the missing refresh line is the injected mutation or a latent upstream flake, since no trustworthy upstream reference is obtainable without network and the module cache's sumdb records don't verify.
